answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, published publicly on failure. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A saffron of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
